questions.explanation: Siddhartha Gautama attained enlightenment at Bodh Gaya (in modern-day Bihar) under a peepal tree, which became known as the Bodhi tree. (Lumbini is his birthplace, Sarnath is where he gave his first sermon, and Kushinagar is where he died).
